_readme: Settings for this GACC. Edit from the website's Criteria tab.
name: Southwest

Standard.description: Southwest High Risk triggers as written in the 7-Day trigger criteria.

triggers.name: Wind
triggers.description: Sustained winds 20 mph or greater or consistent gusts to 35 mph or greater, with RH 15% or less.

triggers.name: Lightning
triggers.description: Scattered thunderstorms with RH below 20%, preceded by several days of hot temperatures and followed by continued low RH or increased winds.

triggers.name: Burn Environment
triggers.description: Temperatures much above typical peak fire season maximum values, with RH 15% or less and elevated low-level instability.
